geographic_bounds._disclosure: PTF-TOLEDO-OH-NEW-MARKET-001 discovery bounding box for the Greater Toledo traveler lodging market. Covers Lucas County (Toledo, Sylvania, Maumee, Oregon, Holland, Waterville, Whitehouse, Swanton/Toledo Express Airport), the northern tier of Wood County (Perrysburg, Rossford, Northwood, Walbridge, Millbury) and, at the southern edge, Bowling Green (Wood County, BGSU) which is carried as a DISCOVERY LEAD and held for founder decision rather than admitted by the box. The northern edge (41.80) reaches past the Ohio/Michigan state line at 41.7327 deliberately: Lambertville and Temperance, Michigan sit inside the box and any lodging found there is a LEAD, classified OUTSIDE_MARKET by the market contract, which admits Ohio municipalities only. This box does not overlap any committed discovery box: Detroit-Ann Arbor starts at min_lat 42.05, Cleveland-Akron-Canton starts at min_lng -82.05, and Dayton ends at max_lat 40.72 / max_lng -83.25. Overlap in a discovery box would in any case be harmless -- ownership is decided per identity by the market contract and MARKET_ID_FIELD, never by which box a coordinate falls in.

coordinate_precision_disclosure: All lat/lng values in this file are low-precision (~2-4 decimal places) approximate municipal-center reference points from general public geographic knowledge. They are seed points for bounded-radius provider queries and for the local OSM extract bbox only; nothing downstream treats them as survey-grade.
